newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds ease with Bund after early gains.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds ease with Bund after early gains.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Austrian bonds followed the German Bund future lower on slim volumes on Tuesday, shrugging off early gains in line with international leads.
Traders predicted the Bund future would drift sidewards between 101.8 and 102 points.
Dealers said the market was lacking sellers at the moment, and noted that the continuing high liquidity position of investors should protect prices at their current levels.
Further gains were not out of the question, despite historically low yield levels, although uncertainty remained as to whether the uptrend would be long lasting.
* 10 year benchmark 5.875 pct bond maturing July 2006 up 50 bps at 100.25 to yield 5.59 pct (5.66) in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.88/96 to yield 5.64/63.
* Latest five-year 4.375 bond maturing February 2002 closed up 20 bps at 98.60 in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 98.37/47 to yield 4.69/4.67 percent.
* AGB future up 35 bps at 108.95 on turnover of 423 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany down one at minus two bps, five-year spread up two at 11 bps.
* Money market rates mixed with three-month VIBOR just higher at 3.317 and overnight money slightly lower at 3.07/3.32.
